title: Freeze the exact integrated v1.0 source
description:
One clean protected-branch commit contains every product, dependency, workflow/tooling, Docker, documentation, core, and profiles change; its trusted freeze workflow uploads and attests the exact immutable handoff before any candidate identity or product artifact exists.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Core maintenance epic 6eb585bc and profiles MVP 9b7b5f9c are both in Done state before this leaf may start; every source-changing readiness leaf is also successfully complete. Their accepted commits are ancestors of the protected release-branch tip, the profile quickstart is present, conflict resolution is complete, and targeted Rust-remediation/core-child serialization is reflected in integrated Cargo.lock/manifests.
- [hard] REQ-02: A fresh fetch/checkout proves HEAD equals the protected remote tip, git status --porcelain=v2 --untracked-files=all is empty, no submodule/worktree input is unresolved, the tree is reproducible from the commit, all product manifests declare 1.0.0, every critical external Action is full-SHA pinned, GitHub immutable releases are enabled, and canonical docs/tooling are present.
- [hard] REQ-03: Normal suites, blocking audits, repository validation, exact MSRV, workflow-contract tests, Docker PR/runtime fixtures, documentation checks, and external core/profile public-contract checks pass on this commit without modifying it.
- [hard] REQ-04: The workflow attests then uploads exactly one overwrite-forbidden `freeze-root-v1.0.0-<SHA>-run<R>-attempt<A>` manifest at 90-day retention, recording SHA/tree, protected branch/ref, prerequisite issue/commit IDs, workflow/tool-policy digests, suite run IDs, immutable-release setting, timestamp, repository/actor/event/run identity, and absence of candidate/final tags, public npm 1.0.0, GHCR :1.0.0, and GitHub v1 release. Its exact artifact ID/digest/expiry and attestation verification are retained in the run summary for reviewer selection.
- [hard] REQ-05: This leaf creates no tag and no native, source, MCP, or OCI candidate. Failed/ambiguous upload, retention below 90 days, any later source commit, dirty input, changed workflow definition, or external-epic amendment invalidates the freeze and requires a new freeze artifact before candidate creation; no downstream leaf may patch source in place.

## Notes

Blast radius: read-only integration verification plus one immutable attested freeze artifact. At breakdown, attach `6eb585bc` and `9b7b5f9c` directly here; do not insert a milestone/checkpoint container and do not defer core completion to rehearsal.
